1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use; and __a modulation control system configured to modulate valve operation based on real-time feedback to achieve precise braking pressure control independent of initial valve state__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least three__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger and smaller valves operate in coordinated sequence to achieve graduated braking response__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed __and are independently controlled from the larger valves__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators __and wherein the control means includes a processor configured to execute a control algorithm that dynamically adjusts valve actuation timing based on sensed brake chamber pressure__.

6. (Original) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __wherein the control means continuously updates the optimum braking force calculation during a braking event__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means adjusts the optimum speed calculation in real-time based on changing road surface conditions detected through wheel speed sensor variations__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank; __wherein the system includes a pressure regulator configured to maintain storage tank pressure within a predetermined range and a feedback control loop that monitors and adjusts system operation based on brake chamber pressure measurements__.
